detail.longDescription: Tech news without the noise: https://hax0r.zip One page with the front pages of Hacker News, Lobsters and Slashdot, plus Linux and BSD news, self-hosting, language weeklies, new repos, small personal blogs and a good handful of Lemmy communities. It refreshes through the day. No JavaScript, no trackers, no ads. If you'd rather read it in your feed reader, there's an Atom feed. # Tech # SmallWeb # SelfHosted # Linux # BSD # OpenSource # IndieWeb # RSS # Fediverse
